rules.logic: BIOC(MP-011 w3wp IIS Worker In-Memory Backdoor Child Process) AND BIOC(MP-011 Ntospy Network Provider DLL Credential Interception) AND (BIOC(MP-011 WMI-Spawned SQL sa CSV Export via mssq bat) OR XQL(MP-011 STAR-Delimited Encrypted HTTPS Exfil from w3wp)) within 900s on the same agent_hostname — fuses the IIS in-memory backdoor execution (EDR), the network-provider credential interception (identity/ITDR), the SQL sa CSV export (endpoint), and the STAR-delimited AES/gzip HTTPS egress (NDR) into one Phantom Taurus credential-access incident anchored to the w3wp.exe causality chain on a single IIS host. The stitch is the declared causality spine: the credential-theft and credential-reuse stages join on the shared host entity (shared_entity, stitching_key = src_host / agent_hostname), and the w3wp endpoint process is joined to its outbound HTTPS exfil session (endpoint_network_stitch); every stage resolves to the same causality_actor_process = w3wp.exe (the CGO).
rules.name: Phantom Taurus NET-STAR Credential-Access Incident — Cross-Plane Stitch
